```{r}
#| label: setup
library(pondeR)
library(dimsprepr)
library(gt)
library(knitr)
```

## Configuration

Edit only this section. Each dataset needs a samples x features table
(`features`) and a sample table (`metadata`), either as data frames already in
the R session or as file paths (`.csv` / `.xlsx`). Set `use_demo <- FALSE` to
use your own data.

Normalization per dataset:

- `normalize_method = "median"` (e.g. serum), or
- `norm_factor_col = "SpecificGravity"` (e.g. urine): name of the numeric
  metadata column holding the per-sample normalization values (also set
  `normalize_qc_method` = `"mean"`, `"median"` or `"none"` for the QC rows). This overrides
  `normalize_method` (`"specific_factor"`). QC rows may be `NA`.

```{r}
#| label: config
use_demo <- TRUE

# Shared column names in metadata (override per dataset if they differ)
common <- list(
  sample_id_col = "Sample",
  group_col     = "Group",
  batch_col     = "Batch",
  injection_col = "InjectionSequence",
  qc_types      = "QC",
  control_group = NULL,  # reference level for ROC (NULL = first alphabetically)
  fc_up         = 1.5,   # fold change thresholds (raw scale)
  fc_down       = 1 / 1.5,
  extra         = list() # any other run_DIpreprocess() arguments
)

if (use_demo) {
  make_demo <- function(n = 120, p = 60, seed, sg = FALSE, effect = 4,
                        groups = c("Control", "Case")) {
    set.seed(seed)
    # QC every 5th injection so each batch has >= min_qc_per_batch QCs
    grp <- rep("QC", n)
    grp[-seq(1, n, by = 5)] <- sample(rep(groups, each = (n - n / 5) / length(groups)))
    meta <- data.frame(
      Sample = paste0("S", seq_len(n)), Group = grp,
      Batch = rep(1:3, length.out = n) |> sort(),
      InjectionSequence = seq_len(n)
    )
    if (sg) meta$SpecificGravity <- ifelse(grp == "QC", NA, runif(n, 1.015, 1.025))
    up <- rep(c(effect, rep(1, 5)), length.out = p)  # median-normalization removes effects shared by most features
    x <- matrix(rlnorm(n * p, log(1e5), 0.4), n, p) *
      (1 + 0.004 * meta$InjectionSequence) *
      outer(!grp %in% c("QC", groups[1]), up, function(a, b) ifelse(a, b, 1))
    dimnames(x) <- list(meta$Sample, paste0("m", seq_len(p)))
    rownames(meta) <- meta$Sample
    list(features = as.data.frame(x), metadata = meta)
  }
  # Serum demo has 3 groups to show the multi-group path (PLS-DA + pairwise ROC)
  serum_demo <- make_demo(seed = 5129, groups = c("Control", "Mild", "Severe"))
  urine_demo <- make_demo(seed = 802, sg = TRUE)
  serum_features <- serum_demo$features; serum_metadata <- serum_demo$metadata
  urine_features <- urine_demo$features; urine_metadata <- urine_demo$metadata
}

datasets <- list(
  Serum = modifyList(common, list(
    features = serum_features, metadata = serum_metadata,
    normalize_method = "median"
  )),
  Urine = modifyList(common, list(
    features = urine_features, metadata = urine_metadata,
    norm_factor_col = "SpecificGravity",
    normalize_qc_method = "median"  # QC rows have no SG value: how to normalize them
  ))
)

# Results are saved here (one sub-folder per dataset)
out_dir <- "results"
```

```{r}
#| label: helpers
read_any <- function(x) {
  if (is.data.frame(x) || is.matrix(x)) return(as.data.frame(x))
  switch(tolower(tools::file_ext(x)),
         csv  = read.csv(x, check.names = FALSE),
         xlsx = openxlsx::read.xlsx(x),
         stop("Unsupported input: ", x))
}

preprocess_ds <- function(ds) {
  feat <- read_any(ds$features)
  meta <- read_any(ds$metadata)
  rownames(feat) <- rownames(meta) <- meta[[ds$sample_id_col]]
  do.call(run_DIpreprocess, c(list(
    x = feat, metadata = meta,
    sample_id_col = ds$sample_id_col, group_col = ds$group_col, qc_types = ds$qc_types,
    batch_col = ds$batch_col, injection_col = ds$injection_col,
    normalize_method = ds$normalize_method %||% "median",
    norm_factor_col = ds$norm_factor_col,
    normalize_qc_method = ds$normalize_qc_method %||% "none",
    verbose = FALSE
  ), ds$extra))
}

is_valid_pls <- function(p) {
  !inherits(p, "error") && inherits(p, "run_pls") &&
    NCOL(p$scores) >= 2 && !all(is.na(p$variance_explained))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: run-datasets
#| results: asis
for (nm in names(datasets)) {
  ds <- datasets[[nm]]
  cat("\n\n# ", nm, "\n\n", sep = "")
  di <- tryCatch(preprocess_ds(ds), error = function(e) list(error = conditionMessage(e)))
  if (!is.null(di$error)) {
    cat("Preprocessing failed for ", nm, ": ", di$error, "\n\n", sep = "")
    next
  }
  cat(knitr::knit_child("_metabolomics_dataset.qmd", envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE),
      sep = "\n")
}
```
